subject: Operations
title: The Future of Global Operations
description: A fast breakdown of The Future of Global Operations for builders.

hook.text: Global operations won't disappear. But they're being redesigned for resilience, not just efficiency.

buildup.text: The era of pure cost arbitrage is fading. Companies now optimize for a mix of cost, risk, speed, and sustainability.

discovery.text: Digital tools—AI, digital twins, IoT—let firms manage complex global networks with visibility never possible before.

twist.text: The next disruption is already forming. Companies that survive will be those that built flexibility into their networks.

climax.text: The winning formula: global reach, regional resilience, digital visibility, and agility to pivot when the world shifts.

punchline.text: Global is forever. Fragile is not. Build for both.

quiz.question: What are companies optimizing global operations for now?
options: A mix of cost, risk, speed, and sustainability
